one_liner: Pipedrive has a broad REST API (v1/v2) with OAuth 2.0 and API tokens, webhooks and OpenAPI specs; access needs a paid seat or 14-day trial (sandbox available on request), and the official MCP claim isn't confirmed by the pages.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with apps registered in Developer Hub (client_id/secret). Static personal API token is also supported (query parameter or header).
access_notes: Pipedrive says API access is included with every plan. The homepage offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card. The docs offer a developer sandbox account on request. A third-party page says a paid account is required, yet also calls the sandbox free, so a permanent free path is unclear. Trial is the most defensible path.
blocker_notes: No permanent free plan; a trial, a paid seat or a requested sandbox is needed for working credentials. A token-based daily budget applies per account. The MCP claim has no support in the provided pages and the registry signal is empty.
